function: Resource allocation (batch size, sensing power, CPU speed, AirComp receive power) for over-the-air FL; excluded because the link is single-antenna at server and devices, no RIS (p. 3).
notes: Excluded for system. The server has a single-antenna access point and every device a single-antenna ISAC transceiver (p. 3), with Rayleigh fading and no RIS (p. 9), in an over-the-air FL work (area 7 by the AirComp aggregation, p. 5; area 5 would fall under the same rule). The earlier checks pass: the FL-over-the-air clause covers no_learning, since the ISCC design comes from convex optimization with closed-form KKT solutions (pp. 7-9) and the learned element is the ResNet-10 trained across the devices (p. 9); AirComp and sensing power are optimized jointly with batch size and CPU speed, so above_phy does not apply. If the reviewer reads the batch-size and CPU-speed allocation as edge computing, the code would be above_phy and the decision stays exclude. The pdf_text.py page markers of this file do not follow the PDF from page 10 on (figure text is misplaced), so the pages cited are PDF pages, checked by rendering pages 9-14. The PDF is the arXiv version 2508.15185v1, read as preprint.
